purpose: Creator-published FiveM character and animal models with server setup notes.

items.name: Popcorn RP Pets
items.author: Popcorn RP and credited contributors
items.description: A free collection of animal models including a Chow Chow, a Dobermann, K9 dogs, an armadillo and a robot dog.
items.previewCaption: Popcorn RP’s preview of its FiveM animal models.
requirements: Keep fxmanifest.lua, data and stream together in a resource folder named popcornrp-pets and add ensure popcornrp-pets to server.cfg.
Read the model name from the matching peds.meta entry. Pet interactions require a separate compatible resource such as keep-companion-ox.

items.name: Pablo ‘Fat Cop’ Taco
items.author: TehHitman
items.description: A free human character model with casual outfits and police uniform variants for LSPD, BCSO and SAHP.
items.previewCaption: TehHitman’s preview of the Pablo Taco character model.
requirements: Open cfx-pablo-hitman.zip on the author’s repository and use the enclosed FiveM resource folder.
Start the resource by its folder name. Use the supplied model name in your server’s ped selector and test the outfit variants.

items.name: Anubis
items.author: SSERAFIM MODS
items.description: A fantasy character model with multiple eye and body variants and levels of detail for different viewing distances.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Paid Tebex release · Asset Escrow
requirements: Place the supplied sera_anubis folder in your server’s resources folder and add ensure sera_anubis to server.cfg.
Use sera_anubis as the model name in your server’s ped selector.
